工作流程更新：anima-base-v3.7.1

更新后的工作流程（anima-base-v3.7.1）已正式重新上传！此版本建立在 v3.0 和 v2.5 的重大修改的基础上，带来了精致的提示模板、新的着色样式和关键的后端稳定性。

🌟 v3.7.1 中的新增功能

  • 新样式提示模板：添加了专用提示模板细胞着色, 软阴影（薄涂）, 半绘画风格, 和绘画性（厚画）.

  • 提示修复：对现有提示模板进行了各种优化修复，以实现更流畅的生成。

📦 推荐机型升级

为了使用新的审讯模板获得最佳结果，强烈建议下载最新的 LLM 提示审讯模型：

👉 SC117/gemma-4-12B-it-heretic-QAT-GGUF · 拥抱脸

🛠️ 完整的安装和设置指南

如果您从旧版本（v3.0 之前）升级，则需要安装两个核心自定义节点生态系统并将您的 LLM 模型放置在正确的目录中。

1. 安装所需的自定义节点

打开终端，导航到 ComfyUI 自定义节点目录，然后运行以下命令：

重击

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
# 节点 1：LLM 文本处理器（Gemma 4 必需）
git 克隆 https://github.com/KingManiya/ComfyUI-LLM-text-processor.git
# 节点 2：Anima 风格浏览器（风格调色板和切换器必需）
git 克隆 https://github.com/mizukir0418-gif/ComfyUI-Anima-Style-Explorer-Prompt.git

（或者，您可以直接从 GitHub 下载 ZIP 文件并将其解压到您的自定义节点文件夹，确保没有-主要后缀保留在文件夹名称中）。

2.放置LLM模型

  • 型号链接：下载gemma-4-12b-it-未经审查-GGUF（或推荐的异端QAT变体）来自拥抱脸。

  • 存储路径：放置.gguf文件严格位于：ComfyUI/模型/法学硕士/

⚠️ 关键故障排除：修复首次加载错误

🚨 重要：由于 Gemma 4 采用全新的架构，LLM 节点中内置的较旧的默认后端将抛出错误（例如，未知的投影仪类型或推理失败）在第一次运行时。

如果您的 ComfyUI 崩溃或出错，请按照以下手动步骤更新后端：

  1. 下载最新的后端：去官方llama.cpp GitHub 发布.

  2. 选择正确的文件：下载与您的 GPU 设置相对应的最新版本 zip（例如，Windows x64 (CUDA 13) - CUDA 13.3 DLL或 CUDA 12 变体）。

  3. 找到目标文件夹：在您的 ComfyUI 目录中导航到此处：

    ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-LLM-文本处理器/vendor/llama.cpp/b8840/win-x64-cuda13/

  4. 替换文件：解压下载的 zip 并将所有文件直接复制粘贴到win-x64-cuda13文件夹，覆盖现有的。

  5. 重新启动：重新启动您的 ComfyUI 后端。

🚀 核心功能回顾（v2.5 – v3.0 累积）

如果您错过了之前的主要更新，以下内容现已完全集成到您的v3.7.1管道：

🎨 3 个杰作调色板模板

集成的 JoyCaption 优化美学模板可立即提升您的纹理：

调色板模板视觉公式照明和纹理❄️ 静音/莫兰迪色低饱和度色调（灰玫瑰色、鼠尾草绿、柔和的灰蓝色）搭配柔和的灰色底色。去除刺眼的数字霓虹色。漫射阴光、最小对比度、零刺眼阴影。画廊级的审美。🍂 复古 / 90 年代动漫通过丰富、温暖的棕褐色底色和褪色的怀旧色彩，营造出 20 世纪 90 年代的卡通渲染美感。注入光学复古胶片颗粒和微妙的色差（镜头边缘渗色）。🖤 颜色分割/选择性颜色将环境、背景、皮肤和主要服装锁定为丰富、高对比度的单色灰度。以高饱和度颜色隔离单个视觉焦点项目（例如红唇、发光珠宝）。

🧩 扩展的 4 节点生态系统

您的工作空间现在作为工业级生产管道运行：

  1. Anima 2B 动态组切换器：自动化工作流程交通控制器。

Workflow Update: anima-base-v3.7.1

The updated workflow (anima-base-v3.7.1) has been officially re-uploaded! This release builds upon the major overhauls from v3.0 and v2.5, bringing refined prompt templates, new shading styles, and critical backend stability.

🌟 What's New in v3.7.1

  • New Style Prompt Templates:Added dedicated prompt templates forCel-shading, Soft Shading (Thin Painting), Semi-Painterly, andPainterly (Thick Painting).

  • Universal Prompt Interrogation:Added a general prompt reversal/interrogation template to streamline your tag extraction.

  • Prompt Fixes:Sneaked in various optimization fixes to existing prompt templates for smoother generations.

📦 Recommended Model Upgrade

To get the best results with the new interrogation templates, it is highly recommended to download the latest LLM prompt interrogation model:

👉 SC117/gemma-4-12B-it-heretic-QAT-GGUF · Hugging Face

🛠️ Complete Installation & Setup Guide

If you are upgrading from an older version (pre-v3.0), you will need to install two core custom node ecosystems and place your LLM model in the correct directory.

1. Install Required Custom Nodes

Open your terminal, navigate to your ComfyUI custom nodes directory, and run the following commands:

Bash

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
# Node 1: LLM Text Processor (Required for Gemma 4)
git clone https://github.com/KingManiya/ComfyUI-LLM-text-processor.git
# Node 2: Anima Style Explorer (Required for Style Palettes & Switcher)
git clone https://github.com/mizukir0418-gif/ComfyUI-Anima-Style-Explorer-Prompt.git

(Alternatively, you can download the ZIP files directly from GitHub and extract them into yourcustom_nodesfolder, ensuring no-mainsuffixes remain in the folder names).

2. Place the LLM Model

  • Model Link:Downloadgemma-4-12b-it-uncensored-GGUF(or the recommendedheretic-QATvariant) from Hugging Face.

  • Storage Path:Place the.gguffile strictly inside:ComfyUI/models/LLM/

⚠️ Critical Troubleshooting: Fixing First-Time Loading Errors

🚨 IMPORTANT:Because Gemma 4 utilizes a brand-new architecture, the older default backend built into the LLM node will throw an error (e.g.,unknown projector typeorinference failed) on its first run.

If your ComfyUI crashes or errors out, follow these manual steps to update the backend:

  1. Download the Latest Backend:Go to the officialllama.cpp GitHub Releases.

  2. Select the Right File:Download the latest release zip corresponding to your GPU setup (e.g.,Windows x64 (CUDA 13) - CUDA 13.3 DLLsor the CUDA 12 variant).

  3. Locate the Target Folder:Navigate here inside your ComfyUI directory:

    ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-LLM-text-processor/vendor/llama.cpp/b8840/win-x64-cuda13/

  4. Replace the Files:Extract the downloaded zip and copy-paste all files directly into thewin-x64-cuda13folder,overwritingthe existing ones.

  5. Restart:Restart your ComfyUI backend.

🚀 Core Features Recap (v2.5 – v3.0 Cumulative)

If you missed the previous major updates, here is what is now completely integrated into yourv3.7.1pipeline:

🧠 Gemma 4 Integration & Advanced Tag Reversal

Handles highly detailed, Danbooru-style descriptive captioning, advanced anatomical logic conversion (perfect for gender-bending and complex character transformations), and precise prompt refinement. (Includes optimized tag-interrogator prompt templates for terms like 'femboy').

🔥 Core Node: [Anima 2B Dynamic Group Switcher]

Say goodbye to manually toggling dozens ofrgthreegroups!

  • Automatic Group Name Detection:Connecting a slot to a style group automatically reads the group's title and re-labels the input port natively.

  • Automatic Bypass Matrix Control:Selecting an option from theactive_styledropdown automatically activates that group while instantly forcing all unselected groups into Bypass mode (turning them gray).

  • Zero-Crash Backend:Built-in validator completely eliminates native ComfyUIValue not in listruntime errors when switching styles mid-generation.

🎨 The 3 Masterpiece Palette Templates

Integrated JoyCaption-optimized aesthetic templates to instantly elevate your textures:

Palette TemplateVisual FormulaLighting & Texture❄️ Muted / MorandiLow-saturation tones (dusty rose, sage green, muted grayish blue) over soft grey undertones. Strips away harsh digital neon colors.Diffused overcast lighting, minimal contrast, zero harsh shadows. Gallery-grade aesthetic.🍂 Retro Vintage / 90s AnimeForces a 1990s cel-shaded aesthetic with rich, warm sepia undertones and faded nostalgic colors.Injects optical vintage film grain and subtle chromatic aberration (lens edge color-bleeding).🖤 Color Split / Selective ColorLocks environment, background, skin, and primary attire into a rich, high-contrast monochrome grayscale.Isolates a single visual focus item (e.g., red lips, glowing jewelry) in high-saturation color.

🧩 The Expanded 4-Node Ecosystem

Your workspace now operates as an industrial-grade production pipeline:

  1. Anima 2B Dynamic Group Switcher:Automated workflow traffic controller.

  2. Artist Pre-Config Outline:Handles macro-category wrapping and multi-artist nested weight blending.

  3. Anima 2B Prompt Template 1:Core parallel multi-weight artist channel generator.

  4. Anima 2B Prompt Template 2:High-end modifiers, time eras, structural evaluation, and prompt quality scoring.

🚨 Final Upgrade Notice

Because this ecosystem relies heavily on an integrated Frontend JavaScript architecture,you MUST hard-refresh your browser (PressCtrl + F5)after updating and restarting ComfyUI. Failing to clear your browser cache will cause interactive dropdown menus and buttons to malfunction.

Enjoy the new version, and feel free to share your generations or drop any questions in the comments below!
